description: In front of you is a bed with a green sheet and a dark blue pillow, and you’re holding a bright pink cloth. The left hand stays lower and steadier while the right hand moves in from the right to press and rub the pink cloth over the left palm and wrist, briefly bringing both hands together around the cloth as a two-hand object, then continuing the drying motion with the cloth shifting between a left-hand object and a two-hand object.
